plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Hirschmann HiOS switch (HMIT-SYSTEM-MIB, enterprise PEN 248, HiOS tree 1.3.6.1.4.1.248.100). It reports uptime, per-core CPU utilization, memory utilization, optional memory total/free in bytes, and interface traffic. Fan and power-supply are not collected in this pass. Apply only when sysObjectID is under 1.3.6.1.4.1.248.100*; Classic 1.3.6.1.4.1.248.14 devices use switch_hirschmann.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Hirschmann HiOS switch (HMIT-SYSTEM-MIB cpuCoreUtilization, 0-100 percent per cpuIndex and cpuCoreId), averaged across cores.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Hirschmann HiOS switch as a direct percent (HMIT-SYSTEM-MIB memUtilization), averaged across memory indexes.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the Hirschmann HiOS switch in bytes (HMIT-SYSTEM-MIB memTotalKBytes, KiB converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free memory of the Hirschmann HiOS switch in bytes (HMIT-SYSTEM-MIB memKBytesFree, KiB converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used memory of the Hirschmann HiOS switch in bytes, derived as total minus free after converting KiB to bytes.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
